people.name: Esdras
people.description: Priest-scribe and seer; narrator of the visions in Babylon and recipient of the 5 Ezra oracles.
people.descent_note: 1:1 calls him 'son of Saraias' (Seraiah, the high priest executed in 586 BCE, cf. Ezra 7:1); Seraiah is a distant ancestor, not the literal father, so no parent is listed.
people.identity_note: 3:1 'I Salathiel, also called Esdras' identifies the 4 Ezra visionary with Ezra the scribe; this Salathiel is NOT Shealtiel the father of Zerubbabel (shealtiel-1ch3, also aliased Salathiel). The setting 'thirtieth year after the ruin of the city' in Babylon (3:1) is pseudepigraphic and conflicts with Ezra's 5th-century date. 1:3 places him as a captive in Media under Artaxerxes. 8:19 and 14:9 speak of his being 'taken up'.

people.name: Saraias
people.description: Named as Ezra's father/ancestor at the head of the priestly genealogy.
people.identity_note: Same position as Seraiah in Ezra 7:1.

people.name: Azaraias
people.description: Priestly ancestor of Ezra, son of Helkias.
people.identity_note: Azariah of Ezra 7:1.

people.name: Helkias
people.description: High priest in the ancestry of Ezra.
people.identity_note: Hilkiah of Ezra 7:1 / 1 Chr 6:13.

people.name: Salemas
people.description: Priestly ancestor of Ezra, son of Sadoc.
people.identity_note: Shallum of Ezra 7:2.

people.name: Sadoc
people.description: Priestly ancestor of Ezra, son of Ahitob.
people.identity_note: Zadok of Ezra 7:2 (the later Zadok of 1 Chr 6:12, not David's priest).

people.name: Ahitob
people.description: Priestly ancestor of Ezra.
people.descent_note: 1:1-2 makes him 'son of Achias, son of Phinees, son of Heli', inserting Eli's house (cf. 1 Sam 14:3) into the Zadokite line of Ezra 7:2-3; this is a genealogical conflation, so no parent is listed.
people.identity_note: Positionally Ahitub of Ezra 7:2 (father of Zadok).

people.name: Achias
people.description: Figure in Ezra's genealogy in 5 Ezra, called son of Phinees son of Heli.
people.identity_note: Absent from Ezra 7. Likely echoes Ahijah son of Ahitub son of Phinehas son of Eli (1 Sam 14:3; existing ahimelech-1sa14 carries alias Ahijah), but there he is Phinehas's grandson, so identity is not clear enough to merge.

people.name: Phinees (son of Heli)
people.description: Son of Heli (Eli) in the inserted section of the genealogy.
people.identity_note: First 'Phinees' in 1:2; 'son of Heli' identifies him with Phinehas son of Eli (1 Sam 1:3).

people.name: Heli
people.description: Eli the priest, placed in the genealogy as son of Amarias.
people.descent_note: 1:2 calls him 'son of Amarias'; Amariah of Ezra 7:3 is a much later Zadokite and Eli's father is never named in the Hebrew Bible, so this is a conflation, not a parent link.
people.identity_note: Heli = Eli the priest of Shiloh (Greek form); identity inferred from 'Phinees son of Heli'.

people.name: Amarias
people.description: Priestly ancestor of Ezra, son of Aziei.
people.identity_note: Amariah of Ezra 7:3.

people.name: Aziei
people.description: Priestly ancestor of Ezra.
people.descent_note: 1:2 'son of Marimoth' follows Ezra 7:3, which skips several generations listed in 1 Chr 6:7-10; Meraioth is a distant ancestor, so no parent is listed.
people.identity_note: Aziei stands where Ezra 7:3 has Azariah (son of Meraioth, father of Amariah); mapped positionally.

people.name: Marimoth
people.description: Priestly ancestor of Ezra, son of Arna.
people.identity_note: Meraioth of Ezra 7:3.

people.name: Arna
people.description: Priestly ancestor of Ezra, son of Ozias.
people.identity_note: Arna stands exactly where Ezra 7:4 has Zerahiah (son of Uzzi, father of Meraioth); mapped positionally, the name form is corrupt.

people.name: Ozias
people.description: Priestly ancestor of Ezra, son of Borith.
people.identity_note: Uzzi of Ezra 7:4 (not King Uzziah despite the form Ozias).

people.name: Borith
people.description: Priestly ancestor of Ezra, son of Abissei.
people.identity_note: Bukki of Ezra 7:4; mapped positionally.

people.name: Abissei
people.description: Priestly ancestor of Ezra, son of Phinees.
people.identity_note: Abishua of Ezra 7:5.

people.name: Phinees (son of Eleazar)
people.description: Phinehas son of Eleazar, grandson of Aaron.
people.identity_note: Second 'Phinees' in 1:2.

people.name: Eleazar
people.description: Son of Aaron in the priestly genealogy.

people.name: Aaron
people.description: First priest; head of Ezra's genealogy and named as Israel's priest in the exodus.

people.name: Artaxerxes
people.description: King of the Persians in whose reign Ezra was captive in Media.
people.identity_note: Assumed to be the Artaxerxes of Ezra 7.

people.name: Pharoah
people.description: King of Egypt struck down with his army at the exodus.
people.identity_note: Pharaoh of the sea crossing; existing data splits the exodus pharaohs and this maps to the later (exodus) one.

people.name: Moses
people.description: Leader of the exodus; recalled as intercessor and recipient of revelation at Sinai.
people.identity_note: 14:4-5 refer to him by pronoun only.

people.name: Abraham
people.description: Patriarch chosen by God; recalled as interceding for Sodom.
people.identity_note: 3:15 refers to him by pronoun.

people.name: Isaac
people.description: Son of Abraham, father of Jacob and Esau.

people.name: Jacob
people.description: Patriarch, son of Isaac, chosen over Esau.
people.identity_note: Uses of 'Jacob'/'Israel' for the nation (1:24, 3:19, 3:32, 5:35, 8:16, 9:30, 12:46) are not counted as person refs.

people.name: Esau
people.description: Isaac's son, rejected in favour of Jacob; symbol of the end of the age.

people.name: Oseas
people.description: Minor prophet listed among leaders of the coming people.

people.name: Amos
people.description: Minor prophet in the list of leaders.

people.name: Micheas
people.description: Minor prophet in the list of leaders.

people.name: Joel
people.description: Minor prophet in the list of leaders.

people.name: Abdias
people.description: Minor prophet in the list of leaders.

people.name: Jonas
people.description: Minor prophet in the list of leaders.

people.name: Nahum
people.description: Minor prophet in the list of leaders.

people.name: Abacuc
people.description: Minor prophet in the list of leaders.

people.name: Sophonias
people.description: Minor prophet in the list of leaders.

people.name: Aggaeus
people.description: Minor prophet in the list of leaders.

people.name: Zachary
people.description: Minor prophet in the list of leaders.

people.name: Malachy
people.description: Minor prophet, 'also called the Lord's messenger'.

people.name: Esaias
people.description: Prophet promised as a helper to the mother of the children.

people.name: Jeremy
people.description: Prophet promised alongside Esaias.

people.name: Adam
people.description: First man, whose transgression brought death on his descendants.

people.name: Noah
people.description: Survivor of the flood with his household.

people.name: David
people.description: King commanded to build a city; intercessor for the plague; ancestor of the anointed one.

people.name: Phaltiel
people.description: Captain of the people who urged Ezra to eat and not abandon the exiles.
people.identity_note: Only in 4 Ezra 5:16-19 (5:19 by pronoun); unrelated to Palti/Paltiel of Samuel or Numbers.

people.name: Joshua
people.description: Moses' successor, interceding for Israel in the days of Achan.

people.name: Achan
people.description: Israelite whose sin occasioned Joshua's intercession.

people.name: Samuel
people.description: Prophet who prayed in the days of Saul.

people.name: Saul
people.description: First king of Israel.

people.name: Solomon
people.description: King who prayed for worshippers and built the city and its offerings.

people.name: Elijah
people.description: Prophet who prayed for rain and for the dead.

people.name: Hezekiah
people.description: King of Judah who prayed in the days of Sennacherib.

people.name: Sennacherib
people.description: Assyrian king in Hezekiah's day.

people.name: Daniel
people.description: Seer whose fourth-kingdom vision the eagle vision reinterprets; called Ezra's 'brother'.
people.identity_note: 'your brother Daniel' = fellow seer, not a sibling.

people.name: Jesus
people.description: Messianic Son of God of the visions.
people.identity_note: Prophetic/visionary references only. 7:28 'my son Jesus' and 7:29 'my son Christ' follow the Latin tradition (other versions read 'my son the Messiah'); 2:47 identifies the crowning young man as the Son of God (5 Ezra, Christian). 12:32 is the anointed one 'out of the seed of David' (bracketed WEB text). The symbolic lion (11:37, 12:31) and man from the sea (13:3, 13:25) stand for him and are excluded as symbols. Reviewer may prefer to drop these as non-historical refs.

people.name: Osea
people.description: King of Israel when the ten tribes were exiled.

people.name: Salmananser
people.description: King of the Assyrians who deported the ten tribes.

people.name: Sarea
people.description: One of the five swift scribes who wrote the 94 books at Ezra's dictation over forty days.
people.identity_note: Named only at 14:24, then 'the five men' (14:37, 14:42); gender from 'five men'.

people.name: Dabria
people.description: One of the five swift scribes who wrote the 94 books at Ezra's dictation over forty days.
people.identity_note: Named only at 14:24, then 'the five men' (14:37, 14:42); gender from 'five men'.

people.name: Selemia
people.description: One of the five swift scribes who wrote the 94 books at Ezra's dictation over forty days.
people.identity_note: Named only at 14:24, then 'the five men' (14:37, 14:42); gender from 'five men'.

people.name: Ethanus
people.description: One of the five swift scribes who wrote the 94 books at Ezra's dictation over forty days.
people.identity_note: Named only at 14:24, then 'the five men' (14:37, 14:42); gender from 'five men'.

people.name: Asiel
people.description: One of the five swift scribes who wrote the 94 books at Ezra's dictation over forty days.
people.identity_note: Named only at 14:24, then 'the five men' (14:37, 14:42); gender from 'five men'.

excluded_names.Israel: people/nation (never used for Jacob personally in this book)
excluded_names.Phinees: two persons, see the two Phinees entries
excluded_names.Son: title (Son of God / my Son) - see Jesus entry
excluded_names.young man of high stature (2:43): symbolic visionary figure, identified as the Son of God (2:47; ref counted under Jesus)
excluded_names.Ezra's mother (5:35): rhetorical mention only, not an actor

notes: Verse ranges checked against the WEB text: ch1 has 40 verses, ch2 48, ch14 ends at 14:48, ch15 has 63, ch16 78. Ch7 has 140 verses (includes the 'missing fragment' 7:36-105, so numbering follows the long form). Each person has a 'sections' list derived from refs. 6 Ezra (15-16) names no humans (only nations/places such as Babylon, Asia, Egypt, Arabia, Carmonians). The 5 Ezra 1:1-3 genealogy matches Ezra 7:1-5 position-for-position except for an inserted 'Achias, Phinees, Heli' (Eli's house) between Ahitob and Amarias; corrupt forms Aziei (=Azariah), Arna (=Zerahiah), Borith (=Bukki), Ozias (=Uzzi) were mapped positionally. Parent links are given only where they agree with 1 Chr 6; telescoped or conflated links are explained in descent_note (Esdras-Saraias, Ahitob-Achias, Heli-Amarias, Aziei-Marimoth). The narrator 'I' is Ezra throughout 3-14; only verses naming him are listed. The 5 Ezra prophets list (1:39-40) is mapped to the canonical prophets. The Jesus entry contains prophetic/visionary refs only; the reviewer may decide whether to keep them. Bracketed WEB text at 12:32 and 13:3 is supplied from versions.
